title: Themes
description: Colours for the whole app, a document's page and a public page, each taken from an archipelago's own colours, as the ridges drawing reads them from photos of the place: only its paper, its ink, its sea and, for some, a mark its links are made from (a moss, a lava, a lupin), the rest worked out from them so text, muted words, links and states keep their contrast. None is used until the owner keeps a version of one.
